description: Make cam init's auto-merge notice quiet-gated via printHint, matching cam config (init/config parity).

userStories.title: Quiet-gate printAutomergeNotice via printHint
userStories.description: As a cam operator running cam init in quiet mode, I need the auto-merge prerequisite notice to be suppressed like every other hint so that quiet mode is honored consistently and cam init matches cam config (init/config parity).
acceptanceCriteria: printAutomergeNotice's default writeFn routes through the quiet-gated printHint (imported from src/logging/color.ts), so the notice is emitted via the same suppression mechanism as cam config. [oracle: file-assert: grep -q "printHint" src/logging/notices.ts]

The raw process.stdout.write default is removed from printAutomergeNotice (no longer the default writeFn for the notice). [oracle: file-assert: ! grep -q "process.stdout.write" src/logging/notices.ts]

With the default writeFn (no injected fn) and quiet mode OFF (setQuiet(false)), calling printAutomergeNotice() emits the AUTOMERGE_NOTICE text. [oracle: bun test test/commands/setup-automerge-notice.test.ts]

With the default writeFn (no injected fn) and quiet mode ON (setQuiet(true)), calling printAutomergeNotice() emits nothing (notice suppressed). The test drives the real isQuiet toggle via setQuiet from src/logging/color.ts and asserts written-vs-suppressed (not a tautology). [oracle: bun test test/commands/setup-automerge-notice.test.ts]
The existing injected-writeFn test still passes (callers can still inject a capture fn for unit tests). [oracle: bun test test/commands/setup-automerge-notice.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
